milestoneTitle: M5: 10 条历史 completed 任务证据重审 (M1/M2 遗留 JSON-only)
milestoneAcceptance: M5.S1: 生成只读 audit snapshot (tools/axi-todo/.m1-snapshot/m5-audit/snapshot.json) 固定 10 条 completed 任务的 id / title / cwd / verifyCommand / history / verification 字段,字节级冻结 (SHA256 已记录),任务状态零修改
M5.S2: M5 ledger 落地 (本文件),锁定 5 项 outOfScope;新工具 / 测试 / 文档全部进 m5-audit/ 子目录,不混入 main bin / lib
M5.S3: 逐条 evidence 核查 (verifyCommand / cwd 路径仍存在 / VERIFICATION.md 或 completion_summary 仍可在仓库定位 / 当前代码仍满足任务目标),结果写入 audit/evidence-check.json
M5.S4: 按证据分流:有可复现证据 → 保持 completed 并补 audit note;失败证据 → failed;无法判断 → awaiting_audit;目标已撤销 → cancelled。决策写入 audit/decisions.json
M5.S5: 新增 bin/axi-todo-recheck-completed.mjs + test/recheck-completed.test.mjs (有证据保持 / 无证据转 awaiting_audit / 失败证据转 failed),历史任务重审命令可复跑
M5.S6: 全套测试全绿,Swift smoke 不变,M5 ledger close (verificationStatus: Awaiting owner acceptance)

ownerDecisionsRequired.summary: Whether to run `bin/axi-todo-recheck-completed.mjs --apply --confirm-apply` against $HOME/.axi-todo/tasks.json to reclassify the 7 cancelled tasks (153c3dfc / a73af886 / bbe7e9aa / 48127c15 / 79afc81a / 1b11be6f / ef45ad87) from status='completed' to status='cancelled' and append audit history to the 3 keep-completed tasks (27c6eafa / 5dd3a8c3 / e83da185).
options: Apply all 10 decisions (3 keep-completed append-history + 7 cancelled reclassify)
Dry-run only (do nothing yet; keep decisions.json as audit record)
Cancel — revert M5; keep all 10 tasks status='completed' as before
ownerDecisionsRequired.default: Dry-run only (decisions.json is the audit record; --apply requires explicit owner confirmation per the script's --confirm-apply gate)
ownerDecisionsRequired.risk: irreversible status flip + history append on the canonical JSON store (--apply writes a backup to .m1-snapshot/m5-audit/pre-apply-<ISO>.json before any mutation, so rollback is recoverable from backup)
